scientific_purpose: On frozen source-trained LATFUSE004 eight checkpoints, test whether source-real high PM2.5 events versus same-source same-hour ordinary observations leave retrievable content traces in the actual 16x16 associative matrix after 16/64/128/512 further genuine readings and whether prefix-associative memory helps or hurts genuine six-hour future outcome forecasts. No optimizer, no new architectures.
source_population: 12 original UCI501 Beijing stations source-original FIT July 2014, sensor readings through August before FIT boundary 2014-09-01; no numerical previously-exposed 2015 DEV or protected 2016-2017 data parsed
event_definition: Anchors are physically observed PM2.5 normalized using TRAIN-FIT center/spread. Source spike threshold PM2.5 z>=1.25, not selected by trained score or future outcomes; at most 2 earliest spaced >=24 real hourly observations per station. Matched same source hour-of-day ordinary anchor abs(PM2.5 z)<=0.25, >=24 hours from spike, earliest nearest by absolute date; no future outcome selection.
cohort_bounds: Original anchor dates July1-July31 2014 only; horizon set16/64/128/512 hours since anchor. All 24 preanchor inputs and continuation observed, source-true chronological. Real+6 future measured target evaluated only AFTER frozen model prediction.

probes.explicit_anchor_key: Source-trained learned key_map at recorded anchor (headwise L2) used to test content-addressed matrix trace M_{t+L} k_anchor vs actual source-trained learned value_map(u_anchor); this is a diagnostic WRITE-key probe, not the model's learned forecast query and not decoding event truth.
probes.retention: Same original source-conditioned suffix for two identical states except one earlier associated [16x16] matrix set to ZERO at anchor; compare actual matrix differences, projected event-key differences and forecasts at delays. Other fast/slow/entity state exactly identical across variants.
probes.forecast_scoring: Read source true +6h 13-channel outcomes only after model.forecast. Compare unchanged full memory versus its isolated earlier-memory zero lesion and last-observed persistence, source-conditioned event/control, missing-label masking, paired delta in physical PM2.5 and normalized 13-channel MAE; no causal intervention claim from out-of-distribution matrix lesion.
probes.null_control: same-source and same-hour-of-day ordinary physical PM2.5 anchor; independent of trained model or future targets. Not a substitute for independently heldout event labels.
probes.identity: all original checkpoint byte SHA and source archive SHA verified before/after, original 6800-byte recurrent state, 8 frozen model variants, 0 optimizer steps
probes.interpretation_limit: Event-conditioned association trace is not factual recalled PM2.5 from a learned past-value query; neither high write-key reconstruction nor local out-of-distribution zero-lesion forecast sensitivity establishes useful event recall. Two prior seeds and FIT-era data; no architecture superiority or real action policy.

restricted_evidence: No source 2015 numerical targets or protected 2016-17 original rows. Synthetic only for unit tests. No new trained original/ablation modules or loss tuning.
source_frozen_future: Separate subsequent exact affine forgetting audit only if these authentic event-conditioned source probes show meaningful differentiable memory transport or identify no causal forecasting value; do not infer improvements from key cosines alone.
